stories.headline: Your smartphone is changing your body. Doctors say most people don’t know it’s happening
stories.dek:
Ask most people what their phone is costing them, and they’ll point to their attention or sleep. But research suggests the cost may also be physical.
Doctors are now using the informal term “phone body” to describe changes that follow years of hunching, squinting, and scrolling.
